mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE image_lineage(image_id, first_registered_at) AS ( SELECT image_id, created_at FROM dataset_image WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId} AND version_count = 1 AND previous_image_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT next_image.image_id, lineage.first_registered_at FROM dataset_image next_image JOIN image_lineage lineage ON next_image.previous_image_id = lineage.image_id WHERE next_image.dataset_id = #{datasetId} ) SELECT image.*, creator.user_id AS creator_user_id, creator.username AS creator_username, updater.user_id AS updater_user_id, updater.username AS updater_username, lineage.first_registered_at FROM dataset_image image LEFT JOIN image_lineage lineage ON lineage.image_id = image.image_id LEFT JOIN auth_user creator ON creator.user_key = image.created_by LEFT JOIN auth_user updater ON updater.user_key = image.updated_by WHERE image.is_deleted = FALSE
